add.issue.name: One expandable header per file diff, not a disclosure row stacked on pierre's

edit.description.md:
In a ticket's Commits tab an expanded file shows two headers: FileRow's own chevron+path button, and beneath it @pierre/diffs' sticky header (change dot, path again, +N/-N). Same name twice, one after the other.

Fold them into one: render our header through pierre's `renderCustomHeader` slot so the single header is the sticky one, carries the chevron, path, comment count, large-diff badge and stat, and toggles the file. Collapsed, the same header stands alone in the bordered box with no diff mounted, so a large file shut still costs nothing.

Applies to the Commits tab in both the side-pane and full-width layouts. The scrubber's DiffPanel keeps pierre's default header.

add.issue.name: A commit's files open expanded in both layouts

edit.description.md:
Today a commit opens its files shut in the side pane and open in the full-width layout, with a remembered "Expand all"/"Collapse all" habit (YCT73R9) deciding the side pane. Reviewing means unfolding first every time the habit was last left shut.

Make files open expanded on arrival in both layouts, dropping the remembered habit: `diff-expansion.ts` goes, and the expand-memory e2e with it. Large files still arrive shut, and "Expand all"/"Collapse all" stays as the per-commit wholesale toggle.

add.issue.name: A "reviewed" checkbox per file diff, remembered in localStorage

edit.description.md:
Reviewing a ticket's commits file by file has nothing that says which ones are done. Put a "reviewed" checkbox in each file diff's header, like GitHub's Viewed.

- Checking collapses the file; unchecking opens it again.
- A reviewed file arrives collapsed when its commit is opened later, so the rest of the commit is what is left to read.
- Remembered per browser in localStorage, keyed by commit sha and path — a file reviewed in one commit says nothing about the same path in another.
- The checkbox sits outside the toggle button, so ticking it does not also fold or unfold the file by accident.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: dbe357a4 on PR #247. FileRow's own disclosure button is gone; a `FileHeader` (chevron, path, comment count, large-diff badge, +N/-N) is handed to pierre's `renderCustomHeader`, so the sticky header is the one that folds the file. Shut, the same header stands alone in the shared `DIFF_BOX_STYLE` box with no `MultiFileDiff` mounted. The stat reads off pierre's parse, so it shows only while open. `aside-stacking.pw.ts` now reads the pinned name off the slot's assigned elements, since the shadow header's own text is empty in custom mode.
add.issue.comment.author: BSSY2ZVJW73PYSRZPVMMH93T0H

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: 994a84dd on PR #247. One effect opens a commit's non-large files the moment its diff first lands, in both layouts; `expandAll` now only opens the commits themselves. `diff-expansion.ts` and `expand-memory.pw.ts` removed; `large-diff.pw.ts` rewritten around open-on-arrival, with "Expand all" still passing the lockfile over.
add.issue.comment.author: BSSY2ZVJW73PYSRZPVMMH93T0H

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: 76229459 on PR #247. `lib/reviewed-files.ts` owns the store (`epiq.commits.reviewedFiles`, a list of `sha:path`, malformed reads as empty) via `useReviewedFiles`. The header's `Checkbox` sits beside the toggle button; ticking folds the file, unticking opens it, and the arrival effect skips reviewed files. Covered by `reviewed-files.pw.ts` (fold, reopen without unticking, survives reload) and a unit test for the store.

add.issue.name: A collapsed file header still shows its +N/-N

edit.description.md: Since VC813XT the file header's +N/-N comes off pierre's parse, so it only appears once the diff is open — a shut file (reviewed, or a large one) says nothing about its size. Have the server count the lines per file alongside the contents (git already knows: numstat), carry `insertions`/`deletions` on `GuiCommitDiffFile`, and draw the stat from that in both states.

add.issue.name: A ticket with a single commit opens it unasked

edit.description.md: In the side pane the Commits tab lists commits shut and waits for a click. With exactly one commit there is nothing to choose between, so open it (and fetch its diff) on arrival, the way the full-width layout does for every commit. Opened once, so collapsing it by hand sticks.

add.issue.name: Commit row: a leading chevron, and the rail dot on the subject's line

edit.description.md:
Two bits of commit-row chrome:

- The open/shut caret sits at the far right after the copy button, easy to miss. Lead the row with it, the way the file headers do, so a row reads as foldable and its state is obvious.
- The rail dot (RAIL_DOT_OFFSET = 19) sits above the subject's text line, not on it. Measure the header's text centre and put the dot there.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: f57d82c4 on PR #248. `getChangedFileBlobs` adds `--numstat` to the existing `git diff --raw` spawn — no extra process — and sorts the two disjoint line shapes, so `CommitDiffFile`/`GuiCommitDiffFile` now carry `insertions`/`deletions` (a binary's `-` reads as 0). `FileHeader` draws `DiffStat` from those in both states; the `FileDiffMetadata` path is gone. Unit tests cover the counts and the binary case; `reviewed-files.pw.ts` asserts the folded file still says `+2`.
add.issue.comment.author: BSSY2ZVJW73PYSRZPVMMH93T0H

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: 4f3bbdeb on PR #248. The commit-opening effect now fires when `expandAll || commits.length === 1`, so a lone commit opens (and fetches its diff) on arrival in either layout, once, via the existing `autoOpenedShas` guard. New `lone-commit.pw.ts`; `fullscreen-lanes.pw.ts` seeds two commits so the tabbed layout still has something shut; `large-diff` and `reviewed-files` no longer click the commit they expect open.
add.issue.comment.author: BSSY2ZVJW73PYSRZPVMMH93T0H

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: 73fb52b3 on PR #248. The caret moved to the front of the commit row, matching the file headers; the trailing one is gone. `RAIL_DOT_OFFSET` is now `1 + COMMIT_HEADER_PADDING + 10` (card border, header padding, half the 20px copy button the subject is centred against) = 24 rather than 19; measured in the browser, dot centre and subject centre now coincide exactly on every card (they were 5px apart).
add.issue.comment.author: BSSY2ZVJW73PYSRZPVMMH93T0H

add.issue.name: epiq skill: a small, tightly coupled follow-up goes into the original ticket

edit.description.md: A request that only makes sense as part of a ticket's work — halving a limit it just introduced, nudging a control it just added — gets filed as a new ticket today (QPPR7PE for MBB6WY5). Add to .claude/skills/epiq/SKILL.md: record the new requirement on the original ticket instead (comment plus description), prefix its commits with that ticket's ref, and note that this holds for any ticket open on the board and assigned to the same agent, not only the one taken this session.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: one bullet added to SKILL.md on PR #249, after "Break work into small, scoped tickets". It says a tightly coupled small request is recorded on the original ticket (comment + description), the ticket goes back to Ongoing if it was Done, the follow-up's commits carry the same ref, and a further `Solution:` comment names them when they land — naming QPPR7PE/MBB6WY5 as the case it avoids. It also states the original may be any open ticket on the board assigned to the agent, not only the one taken this session, and draws the line for a new ticket at work that stands on its own or needs more than a line or two to describe.
add.issue.comment.author: BSSY2ZVJW73PYSRZPVMMH93T0H
